reviews.text:
This app stole my money and didn’t provide!. I am only giving this a one star because it would not let me give it a zero star 
I downloaded this application because it looked very appealing with the types of resume templates that were available. So I was very excited I paid my $10 for the app and then I started filling out everything I needed to create my resume. After creating my resume I found the template that I enjoyed the most and I tried to save it or share it and nothing would happen. I have reached out three different emails to the support team to try to address this issue and at this time no one has responded back to me at all. I really wish there was a way to get my money back I am very disappointed that I have paid for this app I did not give me any product out of video essentially they stole my money.

I wanted to put a zero (0) rating but failed to find the option. I downloaded this app, subscribed and paid in full so that I will be able to quickly generate my CV in time for a job opportunity whose application expires today.

I wasted my time filling in the information only for the application to fail to generate my CV into either PDF or word document. I have been using waiting for the past 2 hours and it’s still loading.

I then emailed my query and was told to wait for 72 hours for a response yet the job opportunity I am applying for expires in a few hours time.

This app is a scam!!! I don’t care much about the money I paid but wasting my time is very bad!!! This app must be removed from apple app store because I downloaded it through my trust for the platform.
